input.summary: Convert mutual no-hire into a narrow 12-month mutual non-solicit limited to personnel directly involved in the services, with general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs.
input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept a no-hire covering any employee of the other party, so we have narrowed this to a mutual non-solicitation limited to personnel directly involved in the services for 12 months from the end of their involvement, with the customary carve-outs for general advertisements and unsolicited approaches. Our preferred position is no non-solicit binding us at all, but we are content with this mutual narrowing.

ops.oldText: During the term of this Agreement and for a period of one year thereafter, both parties agree not to hire or allow its respective affiliates to hire any employee of the other party, or any person who was an employee of the other party during the previous six months and who was directly involved in the provision of services under this Agreement.
ops.newText: During the term of this Agreement and for a period of twelve (12) months after the end of the relevant individual's involvement in the provision of services under this Agreement, neither party shall, and neither party shall permit its affiliates to, directly solicit for employment any employee of the other party who was directly involved in the provision of services under this Agreement. The foregoing shall not restrict either party or its affiliates from (i) placing or responding to general advertisements or recruitment campaigns that are not specifically targeted at the other party's personnel, or (ii) employing or engaging any person who approaches it on an unsolicited basis or who responds to such a general advertisement or campaign.
